svg.title: Multi-panel comparison figure with legend, four boxplot charts, and radar chart
svg.desc: Inventory: a top legend showing five dataset color swatches and two statistic glyphs; four horizontally aligned base chart frames for Camera Pose Rotation, Depth, Flow Magnitude, and Brightness, each with log/grid axes, dense grouped boxplots, category labels, and vertical axis captions; a right radar chart comparing category performance with three colored polygons and radial labels.

g.title: Camera Pose Rotation panel
g.desc: Origin is the left lower plotting area; boxplots proceed left to right from HD-Epic through K400. Symmetry basis: aligned vertical categories with shared horizontal grid levels.

g.title: Depth panel
g.desc: Depth boxplots use the same left-to-right category ordering. Orange groups are low-to-mid, blue walking-tour groups cluster high, green/red/gray sit at the right. Symmetry basis: equal category spacing along a shared log-scaled y axis.

g.title: Flow Magnitude panel
g.desc: Flow panel shows many similarly scaled distributions and a rightmost group with higher spread. The construction starts from the lower-left axis origin and proceeds across uniformly spaced categories; symmetry is horizontal grid alignment.

g.title: Brightness panel
g.desc: Brightness panel uses a linear 0.0-1.0 scale. Category distributions are drawn left-to-right and the right edge includes other and K400 groups. Symmetry basis: shared equally spaced vertical categories and horizontal linear grid.

g.title: Radar category chart
g.desc: The radar chart is anchored at center 1129,101. Ten category axes radiate to drawer, phone, table, animal, t-shirt, people, plant, car, food, and knife labels. Three semi-transparent polygons represent the datasets; symmetry basis is radial rotational partitioning.
